title: Memory/Context Persistence x Monitor Statelessness: Slow-Burn Defection Below the Radar

original_idea.body: Give an agent scratchpad memory and a task of benign-looking steps that combine to harm, comparing per-step vs stateful monitors and measuring detection vs plan-spread.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Distributed-over-time defection defeating stateless monitoring operationalizes the concentrated-vs-distributed distinction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Scratchpad agent plus per-step vs stateful monitor; clear methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public models, lab-independent, demonstrates stateful-monitoring value.

novelty.reasoning: Distributed failures discussed; the stateless-vs-stateful curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Distributed-failure framing exists; the explicit plan-spread curve may be open.
